title: TopologyTargetScope
description: Reference to a prior topology result scope used as the target of a later compile request. This is an opaque handle plus optional expected metadata, not a graph query language.

scopeId.description: Opaque result scope id previously returned by topology-service.

requiredKind.description: Optional expected result-scope kind. topology-service validates this before using the scope.

relationshipId.description: Optional expected relationship id for validation.

catalogIds.description: Optional expected semantic catalog ids for validation.

fallbackPolicy.description: Caller preference when the scope is expired or no longer compatible.
